content_blocks.label: clause_1._Personal_Property
content_blocks.text: I direct that my personal property, including but not limited to my jewelry, art collection, and vehicles, be distributed as follows...

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Real_Property
content_blocks.text: I hereby devise and bequeath my real property located at 456 Oak Avenue, Hilltop City, State of Novaria, to my daughter, Amelia Grey, in fee simple absolute...

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Executor
